certs.pageHint: Public certificates for the API and web listener from an ACME CA (Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL, your own step-ca). The leader orders and renews them; nodes swap them in without a restart.
certs.emptyCertificatesHint: Add a certificate to get a browser-trusted certificate for the API.
certs.emptyDns: No DNS providers. DNS-01 (needed for wildcard names) uses one.

deleteHint.account: The account is removed from the cluster. Certificates that use it must be deleted first.
deleteHint.dns: The DNS provider is removed. Certificates that use it must be deleted first.
deleteHint.certificate: The certificate is no longer renewed or installed. Listeners fall back to the internal CA certificate.

errors.name: Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens (up to 63).
errors.url: Give the https:// URL of the ACME directory.
errors.tos: You must agree to the CA's terms of service.
errors.eab: Give both the EAB key id and the HMAC key, or neither.
errors.hook: The hook must be a file under /etc/orbivisor/acme-hooks/.

account.title: Add an ACME account
account.hint: The cluster creates the account key and registers with the CA right away.
account.tos: I agree to the CA's terms of service
account.eabHint: ZeroSSL, Google and many in-house CAs require it. Leave empty for Let's Encrypt.
account.caHint: Only for an in-house CA whose root browsers do not trust.
account.checked: Account {{name}} is registered with the CA.

dns.title: Add a DNS provider
dns.hint: DNS-01 writes a TXT record through this provider to prove you own the name.
dns.zonesHint: Comma-separated. Certificates pick the provider whose zone covers the name.
dns.hookHint: An executable under /etc/orbivisor/acme-hooks/ on every node.

cert.title: Add a certificate
cert.hint: The leader orders it within a minute and renews it before it expires.
cert.namesHint: Comma-separated. {node} is the node name (per node only); *. names need DNS-01.
cert.keyHint: RSA keys are not supported by this build.
cert.http01Missing: HTTP-01 needs the port 80 listener ([api] http_listen) on every node it covers. Missing on: {{nodes}}.
